messages.content:
I ran a small public-baseline matchup check on Kaggle resources.

The matrix image below shows row-side win rates. Rows are the agent being evaluated, columns are the opponent.

  • pool: 7 public notebook-derived agents + 4 official sample agents
  • format: full round robin, 10 games per pair
  • total: 11 agents / 55 pairs / 550 games
  • errors / draws: 0 / 0

Top overall scores:

  1. Kokinn Lucario: 63%
  2. Biohack Crustle: 63%
  3. Yaroslav Lucario: 62%
  4. Penguin Lucario: 58%
  5. Kacchan Lucario: 58%
  6. Roman Lucario: 56%

This is only a 10-game-per-pair screening run, so I would treat it as a matchup map rather than a final strength ranking. It still highlights sharp matchup holes: for example Biohack Crustle finished tied for first overall, but went 0-10 into Sample Iono and 2-8 into Roman Lucario.
